mechanism: Synthetic trajectory generation (Soft-Verified Generation) for supervised finetuning of repository-specialised coding agents
evidence_scope: Using only supervised finetuning (SFT), SERA achieves state-of-the-art results among fully open-source (open data, method, code) models
evidence_role: We present Soft-Verified Efficient Repository Agents (SERA), an efficient method for training coding agents that enables the rapid and cheap creation of agents specialized to private codebases.
